bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to state government; designating state songs; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 10.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[10.1415] STATE SONGS.

Subdivision 1.

Hail! Minnesota.

The composition of the song "Hail! Minnesota," composed by Truman E. Rickard and Arthur E. Upson, is an official song of the state of Minnesota.

Subd. 2.

Purple Rain.

The composition of the song "Purple Rain," composed by Prince and the Revolution, is an official song of the state of Minnesota.

Subd. 3.

Girl from the North Country.

The composition of the song "Girl from the North Country," composed by Bob Dylan, is an official song of the state of Minnesota.

Sec. 2. COPYRIGHT IN STATE SONGS.

The designation of songs as state songs under Minnesota Statutes, section 10.1415, does not convey any right to perform the songs, create derivative works, or otherwise take action that would violate copyright rights in the songs or recordings of the songs.
additions: The composition of the song "Hail! Minnesota," composed by Truman E. Rickard and Arthur E. Upson, is an official song of the state of Minnesota.
The composition of the song "Purple Rain," composed by Prince and the Revolution, is an official song of the state of Minnesota.
The composition of the song "Girl from the North Country," composed by Bob Dylan, is an official song of the state of Minnesota.

The designation of songs as state songs under Minnesota Statutes, section 10.1415, does not convey any right to perform the songs, create derivative works, or otherwise take action that would violate copyright rights in the songs or recordings of the songs.
